lines.speaker: fence_moro
lines.text: Crew came through with a schedule. Numbers, no names, and eleven stalls gone by Friday.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Let me see it. ...That is my article. That is the clause I wrote, cited to do this.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: I drafted a definition of custody and somebody has used it to move people off a floor. I would like to go and be present while that happens.

choices.text: Every clause gets used like this.
